test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

13 : 163 : : 11 : ? : : 9 : 75
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• 13 : 163 → 13² - 6 = 169 - 6 = 163
 
• 9 : 75 → 92 - 6 = 81 - 6 = 75

Similarly,

 
• 11 : ? → 112 - 6 = 121 - 6 = 115

Hence, '**115**' is the correct answer.
